The '''universal computer interface''' was produced by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]]. It assisted the user in interfacing with and translating unfamiliar computer systems.<ref name="GFT" /> It was also the best and most expensive version of the retractable [[Computer probe/Legends|computer probe]]. This device was used to gain access to the higher programming functions of any [[computer terminal]] and computer networks.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
